intro: Bicycles are an important mode of transportation. They provide a fun and healthy way to get around, and they are also good for the environment.
keyLearnings: You will learn why bicycles are an important mode of transportation
You will learn about the health benefits of riding a bicycle
You will understand how bicycles help reduce our carbon footprint
body: Bicycles are an important mode of transportation. They provide a fun and healthy way to get around, and they are also good for the environment.
Bicycles have been around for a long time and have been used for many different purposes. They are a great way to get exercise and enjoy the outdoors.
In addition to being a fun and healthy way to get around, bicycles are also a great way to reduce our carbon footprint. They produce no emissions and require very little maintenance.
activity: Can you think of a time when you rode a bicycle and felt happy?
